Uploading raw episodes to a server is prohibited. Training on raw episodes is prohibited. The uplift report is published. You can withdraw future uses later.

warnings: Results are attested by this machine only. Nobody else has verified that this run happened as described.
The baseline and the candidate launch in parallel against the same committed task set, under matched configuration, so the two are compared and not merely reported.

Nothing produced here is a public proof. Starting this run evaluates the agent for real and spends model tokens on inference at the model provider you configured. A provider that charges for tokens bills that use to your own account; a model you run yourself sends no bill.
Entering this Climb requires releasing the candidate skill publicly.
